notes.title: Update Notes for 11/22 - Major Update To Controls, Achievements, More
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As of 11/22, we've added a new update which overhauls a large segment of the game; particularly, it improves much of the visuals of the game, adds achievements, and overhauls controller usage.

Full changelog below:

[list]
[*] Visual update and improvements to all levels in the game. 
[*] New achievements, up to 17 achievements now.
[*] Controller fixes and improvements including locking twin stick aim when on controller.
[*] Various other bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: The Lost and The Wicked is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37706278/14f0952180cb26294c0132964d39b4a9e34ad638.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37706278/6eb67a8ea1d35513258f9deeb4726bb2d6b7dfe8.png[/img][/url]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37706278/f30c06342bf191dcb0ca72e5f9168b5c452f69f4.png[/img][/url][previewyoutube=pZbX1L6Mulg;full][/previewyoutube]

The Lost and The Wicked is a Brutal Top Down Twin-Stick Shooter. From the team of 3 that created the first video game weed strain to market our game, we bring you a unique single player experience! After waking up in a wicked world you fight your way through hectic gameplay and bosses as you discover your past and what you did to end up here. This a character story with themes of regret, facing your fears and confronting your past accompanied by a unique grunge art style and an original 2+ hour soundtrack. Hope you enjoy!
